title: Kheli - Help Nearby
shortDescription: Ask the people around you for help, or offer yours. Everything close to home.
fullDescription:
Kheli is a simple way to ask for help from the people near you, and to offer help when you can give it.

Post what you need
Describe the thing you need a hand with, drop a pin on the map, and add a photo if it helps. Your request goes out to people in your area.

See what is close by
Browse requests and offers around you. Narrow the map to your street, your neighbourhood, or the whole city, and get in touch with whoever is nearest.

Built for real neighbourhoods
No endless feed, no strangers on the other side of the country. Kheli only ever shows you what is genuinely nearby.

Sign in with your phone number
One text message and you are in. No password to remember.

Your data stays yours
We do not sell your information and we do not share it with advertisers. You can delete your account, your posts and your photos from inside the app at any time.
